note: Studio looks. 'color' is per-pixel (baked to cube/<id>.cube by studio grade bake); 'finish' is spatial (vignette, grain) and only applied by studio grade apply. Correct white balance and exposure first, then add a look at 60-100% strength.

looks.name: Clean neutral
looks.use: Default for talking heads and UI-heavy edits: gentle S-curve, true whites, +5% saturation

looks.name: Warm premium
looks.use: Founder / lifestyle talking heads: warmer mids and highlights, soft contrast, skin stays natural

looks.name: Teal & orange (light)
looks.use: Cinematic B-roll and promos: cool shadows, warm highlights, restrained so skin is not orange

looks.name: Matte film
looks.use: Editorial / documentary feel: lifted blacks, rolled-off highlights, slightly desaturated

looks.name: Bright & airy
looks.use: Lifestyle, wellness, product on white: lifted mids, low contrast, cool-neutral

looks.name: Moody contrast
looks.use: Serious claims, finance, night scenes: deeper shadows, desaturated, focus pulled to the centre

looks.name: B&W editorial
looks.use: Pull quotes, flashbacks, 'before' halves of a before/after: punchy monochrome

looks.name: Fix green cast
looks.use: Correction, not a look: green-lit studios and fluorescent rooms (e.g. the LGF studio). Apply before any look
